title: Choose Qt-aligned qmlformat settings and format all project QML sources
scope: Backlog item only. Do not configure or apply formatting until implementation is explicitly requested.
request: Select a good qmlformat configuration close to The Qt Company's own QML ordering and formatting conventions, then apply it to all project QML files using the tool available with Qt Creator/the Qt kit.
expected: A repository-wide, repeatable QML style with a checked-in .qmlformat.ini, consistent attribute ordering and layout, and no intended behavior changes.
implementation_notes: Use Qt's official QML Coding Conventions and the installed qmlformat version's supported settings when choosing the final configuration.
A Qt 6.12.0 qmlformat.exe is present at C:/Qt/6.12.0/msvc2022_64/bin/qmlformat.exe. Verify the working CLI and Qt Creator integration when implementing.

Consider four-space indentation, category grouping, spacing between logical sections, and JavaScript semicolons in line with Qt's examples. Final options, including line width and grouping versus alphabetical normalization, remain to be chosen.
Preserve import order unless semantic safety is established: Qt documents that sorting imports can change type resolution.

Include application QML, QML tests, and keyboard .qml.in templates. Preserve template placeholders and conditional resource suffixes; exclude generated build/deployment copies and external Qt sources.
Keep the formatting change separate from functional backlog fixes so behavior changes are reviewable.
acceptance_criteria: Check in a documented .qmlformat.ini with settings justified against Qt's published conventions.
Apply the actual qmlformat tool to every project-owned QML source, including tests and QML templates, without formatting generated or external files.
Preserve import resolution, bindings, child-object semantics, and template substitution behavior.
A second formatting pass produces no additional changes.
Document how to rerun the formatter and how the project configuration is used from Qt Creator.
Review the formatting diff and run tools/verify-windows.ps1 after the eventual formatting pass; no functional fixes should be bundled into it.
evidence: User request followed by explicit clarification on 2026-10-28 that this is still a backlog item. No QML formatting was applied during intake.
